snippet.title: As Long As You're Here - Official Gameplay Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
"As Long As You're Here" is an upcoming videogame releasing in 2025 by Autoscopia Interactive, a Copenhagen-based game studio.

Experience an emotional family drama seen through the eyes of Annie, a woman with Alzheimer's. Annie and her family cope with reversed caretaking roles when she moves from her long-time home. As she unpacks her life, memories of her deceased brother and homes from her past bleed into the present. Players struggle against Annie’s eroding faculties while she makes peace with her deepest regrets.

WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309750/As_Long_As_Youre_Here/?utm_source=youtube
